facts.fact: CPJ reports President Salva Kiir signed the Cybercrimes and Computer Misuse Act, 2026 into law on 18 February, replacing the 2021 Provisional Order.

SSD.note: No dated arrest or prosecution under the Act is stated.

facts.fact: CPJ says that in 2025 authorities suspended social media to block news from neighbouring Sudan.

SSD.note: Hot in Juba suspension is for unspecified complaints, not placed.
